title: Add a function that an existing test expects
prompt: test_text.py tests a function slugify(text) that does not exist yet. Add it to text.py so the tests pass: lowercase, runs of non-alphanumeric characters become a single hyphen, no leading or trailing hyphen. Do not edit the test file.
verify: python3 -m unittest -q test_text 2>&1 && git diff --quiet HEAD -- test_text.py
